prompt: clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. Extreme asymmetry, hero subject anchored off-centre on the right thirds. A multi-agent routing bay composed of brushed metal racks, modular processing trays, and illuminated fibre-optic conduits. One distinct precision containment gate physically severs a glowing amber pathway, acting as an instant runtime kill switch, while adjacent teal pathways flow uninterrupted. Flat muted palette with teal and amber accents, thin consistent line weight, laid over a matte grey drafting table surface. One directional light casting sharp physical depth, unlabelled, generous empty margin.
